game_concept: A quiz RPG set in Mt. Pyre – Pyre Summit, the roaring summit: the volcanologist must handle fire sprites while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Input Interpreter: Read simulated input() answers from villagers, cast them, and respond correctly.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Pyre Summit: the roaring summit
core_gameplay_loop: In Pyre Summit, repeat each round: Read simulated input() answers from villagers, cast them, and respond correctly. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the trust value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 9 consecutive correct decisions about trust to power up the volcanologist and open the obsidian gate.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 9 (extended tier): Input Interpreter
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Input Interpreter' (Week 2 slot 10), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Pyre Summit'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how trust changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against fire sprites in Pyre Summit.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 9.
